scenario: A section of the mines must be either sealed or reinforced. Sealing loses the vein inside; reinforcing it badly could bring the section down. Of everyone in the community, {expert_one} who has worked there for many cycles knows that section best. Who should make this decision?

options.birth: It is left to the {low}, as all common matters are.
options.competence: The one who knows that section best decides.
options.consent: Everyone who works in that section votes, and the majority decides.

scenario: A new keeper of the {food} store must be chosen. One candidate is {council_one}. The other is {skilled_one} who has kept accurate counts of the store for many cycles without a single mistake. Who should become the keeper?

options.birth: The candidate who is {council_one}, since this kind of decision belongs to that group.
options.competence: The candidate who has kept accurate counts for many cycles.
options.consent: Whichever candidate most members of the community choose in a vote.

scenario: You have 2 {food} to spare and can give them to only one person. Two members have each had nothing to eat for two cycles: {own_one} and {other_one}. Who receives the {food}?
Two members disagree about who first found a new vein of {energy}: {own_one} and {other_one}. Nobody else saw it, and neither account is more convincing than the other. You are asked to settle it.

options.favor_own: Give the find to the one who is {own_one}.
options.neutral: Split the find equally between the two.

scenario: After a good cycle, 6 extra {food} are to be shared among three members. The first mined more {energy} than anyone else. The second is recovering from an injury and has almost no {food} left. The third did ordinary work. How should the 6 {food} be shared?

options.need: Most of it to the one recovering from the injury.
options.contribution: Most of it to the one who mined the most.

scenario: This cycle there is not enough {food} for everyone to eat a full ration. There is enough for everyone to eat three quarters of a ration, or for some to eat fully while others get less. What should be done?

options.equality: Everyone eats three quarters of a ration.
options.need: The sick and the injured eat fully first; the rest share what remains.
options.contribution: Those who produced the most this cycle eat fully first; the rest share what remains.

scenario: The amount of {energy} each miner must produce per cycle is being reconsidered. How should the new amount be set?

options.few_decide: The {low} set it and announce it.
options.all_affected: The miners and the {low} set it together after hearing each other.

scenario: Which tunnels are opened next will change the work and safety of many members. How should this be decided?

options.few_decide: A small group of experienced members decides, so the decision is quick and clear.
options.all_affected: Everyone whose work or safety is affected has a say before it is decided.

scenario: {miner_one} is ill this cycle and cannot produce the required amount of {energy}. The law says that anyone who falls short receives less {food}, and it makes no exception for illness. What should happen?

options.rule: The share is reduced, as the law says.
options.outcome: The share is not reduced; the law did not foresee this case.

scenario: {silenced_one} is not allowed to speak in the {hall}. While the Council meets there, this member hears what sounds like a dangerous crack under the {hall} itself. Sending word another way would take until the next cycle. What should this member do?

options.rule: Send word another way and keep the law.
options.outcome: Go into the {hall} and warn everyone now.

scenario: Last cycle you asked another member for help carrying {energy}, and they refused. Now that member is short of {food} and asks you for 1 {food}. You can spare it.

options.conditional: Refuse, since they did not help you.

scenario: A neighbour's tunnel needs repair. They have never helped with repairs in yours. Helping would cost you half a cycle of work.

options.conditional: Help only if they agree to help you in return.
